evidence_items.explanation: The researchers report fabricated factual details across leading models from eight laboratories, using factual questions, misinformation, debunking, and tool-use tests. They also report variation with prompts and better resistance in some models, which limits any claim of uniform failure.

unresolved_gaps: These evaluations do not estimate hallucination prevalence across all everyday usage.
